verdict.rationale: Bento's own marketing says every release is scored against production history "in CI" and catches regressions before users see them, and its CLI is documented as usable from CI. However, there are no first-party docs showing how to run evals in a CI job or how to block a deploy on the results, so this rests on a single thin claim. Missing for 10: documented CI eval workflow/integration, explicit deployment-gating mechanism (pass/fail thresholds, exit codes), eval dataset/scoring configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic. Catches regressions before users do.
Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI
